theme_strategy.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Organic Earthy
theme_strategy.description: A polished, professional operations console. Tactical high-visibility data over a deep earthy/obsidian foundation. Focuses on data density, rapid scanability, and authoritative control.

rules: Never use Inter or Space Grotesk.
KPI labels must be uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

layouts.spacing_scale: Dense and compact for dashboards. Primary containers use p-4 or p-6.
layouts.grid_system: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.card_structure: Flat solid surfaces. 1px crisp borders. NO soft shadows. NO glassmorphism to prevent data refraction. Subtle border-radius max 4px.
patterns: Bento Grid for KPI section: span-1 for summary, span-2 for main chart.
Fixed top or side navigation with dense links.

components.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. Use sharp lines with drop-shadows for a glowing neon data effect. Dark gridlines (#1F2E23).
components.data_tables: Dense rows, left-aligned data, right-aligned metrics. Hover states must highlight the entire row slightly (#1A241C).
components.filters: Shadcn Select/Dropdowns. Sharp edges, dark backgrounds (#121A14). No transparent backgrounds.
components.kpi_cards: Minimalist. Value, label, and a small trend sparkline or % change badge.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: border-collapse style layout or standalone cards with 1px border. No gradients on backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense developer/agritech tool look.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subdued abstract agritech patterns or low-opacity monochrome icons. Minimalist text.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to make it feel tactile, not flat digital black.

motion.transitions: Micro-interactions on hover (bg shift, border highlight). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease) NOT 'transition: all'.
motion.charts: Staggered entrance animations. Lines draw in from left to right.
motion.sensors: Live data points on maps/charts should have a slow, pulsating opacity/scale animation.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass APCA standards. Active/Hover states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='filter-crop-select').

image_urls.instructions: Use as a very low opacity (5-10%) background texture in the login screen, hero section, or empty states to reinforce the agritech theme.
Can be used for profile/account banners or contextual imagery.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: recharts, @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react, sonner.
Build a robust CSV parsing utility (e.g., PapaParse or native JS) that acts as the mocked API layer.
Implement Shadcn UI for core components: Cards (customized to be flat and sharp), Select (for filters), Table, and Sonner for toasts.
Dashboard must be fully responsive: grid-cols-1 on mobile, grid-cols-4 on desktop.
Filters must actively manipulate the CSV dataset and re-render charts.
Do NOT use 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties.
Ensure the theme uses the specific deep green/obsidian palette provided. NEVER use teal green or generic Vercel dark mode (slate).
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, specific transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image generators. Use the provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
